assessment: Exploiting the power of the Drosophila larva as a model, this fundamental study sheds light on the neuronal mechanisms of speed regulation during locomotion. The data obtained using a combination of functional and structural approaches are rigorous and convincing. The identified mechanism of speed regulation could be shared with limbed animals and therefore this work is of relevance to those studying the motor system and locomotion across species.
